Corresponding source for the unmodified WinDivert 2.2.2 components

Upstream repository: https://github.com/basil00/WinDivert
Release tag: v2.2.2
Pinned source commit: 1789526ecfb9ff5397c94f9f54c1a3dc2fb60440
Browse source, license and build instructions:
https://github.com/basil00/WinDivert/tree/1789526ecfb9ff5397c94f9f54c1a3dc2fb60440
Download corresponding source, including build scripts, at no charge:
https://github.com/basil00/WinDivert/archive/1789526ecfb9ff5397c94f9f54c1a3dc2fb60440.zip

The bundled library and driver are unmodified upstream binaries. Their
provenance and hashes are recorded in manifest.json. Upstream source provides
mingw-build.sh and the WDK driver build instructions; compiling a new kernel
driver does not reproduce the upstream publisher's private signing key.

Distributors must maintain access to this corresponding source for the period
required by the applicable license. The source link is an equivalent-access
source notice, not a promise that ROK Battles holds an upstream signing key.
